answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the willow check immediately, the velvet audit keeps the resolved set and the ember replay shows exactly which ids were live. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. Copying the same citations across 33 aliases as a result burns the reading cost 33 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
